verdict.rationale: Logseq ships a local HTTP API server that is enabled in Features, uses bearer-token auth, and exposes a single POST /api dispatch endpoint that can call any plugin-API method (community-documented at plugins-doc.logseq.com). Plugins and the logseq:// protocol add further programmatic entry points, so a broad slice of UI functionality is scriptable, but nothing claims or demonstrates UI parity. Missing for 10: any documented claim or evidence of API/UI feature parity, coverage of UI features like Sync, publishing and whiteboards via the API, a remote/cloud API beyond the local desktop server, an OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and official rather than community-driven API docs.
